period_label: expected to commence between the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2025 and fiscal year 2027; lease terms of 1.5 to 15.5 years
quote: Between the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2025 and fiscal year 2027, we expect to commence leases with future obligations of $4.2 billion primarily of data center and office operating leases, with lease terms of 1.5 to 15.5 years.
